comments.author: Nour
comments.body: Is this the quest to unlock the carriage between San Francisco and the Gulf of Mexico, and if not, which one of the other quests in the chain?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: "On to the Plains of Freedom!" is the quest that grants access to the Great Plains, and subsequently, allows use of the carriage between San Francisco and the Gulf of Mexico. This one doesn't unlock anything that I'm aware of, other than a really cute discovery card.

comments.author: Nour
comments.body: Ahh right then, thank you so much!
